end.summary:
Practised taking-away stories within 9 using subtraction.
Used a number line to count back and compared quantities using “how many more.”
Linked subtraction order with addition; 3 − 5 = 2 was corrected by discussing that 5 cannot be taken away from 3 in this set.
The “how many more” mix-up was corrected after one occurrence; teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised taking-away stories, counting back on a number line, and comparing two amounts. Kabir worked with number pairs and the questions were corrected by showing the quantities; the mix-ups about “how many more” and subtraction order were corrected later in the lesson. At home, use small objects to make pairs and ask, “How many more?” before writing the subtraction sentence.
